result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with sidewalks and a marked crosswalk on at least one leg. While traffic signals are present, the large crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions increase exposure for people walking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corners appear wide, which can allow vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk during pedestrian crossings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles at the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility ladder or zebra markings to all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide crossing distance across multiple lanes increases pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Potential High Vehicle Speeds
hazards.description: The multi-lane one-way street configuration can encourage higher vehicle speeds and aggressive lane changes.
hazards.location_in_image: The roadway traveling from right to left

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and paved sidewalks, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the relatively wide crossing distance increase exposure to vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear right-of-way and timing information for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and approaching drivers.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks and signalization. However, the wide roadway width and lack of a median or refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic during the crossing.
